brief: CEO wants a full website redesign by Monday. Sam is the only frontend dev.
brief_id: CEO minta redesign website sebelum Senin. Sam satu-satunya frontend dev.

scenes.text:
Friday, 3:47 PM.
The CEO just forwarded a Slack message to the entire engineering channel.

id.text:
Jumat, 15:47.
CEO baru saja forward pesan Slack ke seluruh channel engineering.

scenes.text:
Taylor. TAYLOR.

Did you see the Slack? The CEO wants the company website redesigned. By Monday. I'm the only frontend dev on this. I haven't touched that CSS in two years.

id.text:
Taylor. TAYLOR.

Kamu lihat Slack-nya? CEO minta website perusahaan didesain ulang. Sebelum Senin. Aku satu-satunya frontend dev di sini. CSS itu nggak pernah aku sentuh dua tahun terakhir.

scenes.text: I saw it. How bad is the current site?

id.text: Udah lihat. Separah apa sih situsnya?

scenes.text: It's flat white with system fonts and hardcoded hex colours everywhere. No variables, no responsive layout, nothing. The CEO called it "embarrassing" in the message. In writing. To everyone.

id.text: Putih polos, font sistem, hex warna hardcoded di mana-mana. Nggak ada variabel, nggak ada responsive layout, nggak ada apa-apa. CEO nyebutnya "memalukan" di pesan itu. Tertulis. Ke semua orang.

scenes.text: Okay. Before you spiral — have you tried Bob?

id.text: Oke. Sebelum kamu panik — udah coba Bob belum?

scenes.text: Bob. The AI thing IT rolled out last month?

id.text: Bob. Itu tool AI yang IT deploy bulan lalu?

scenes.text:
It's not just an AI thing. I used it last week to audit our entire infrastructure config. It found three misconfigurations I'd been missing for months.

Just open it. Tell it your problem. Exactly like you told me.

id.text:
Bukan sekadar tool AI. Minggu lalu aku pakai buat audit seluruh config infrastruktur. Nemu tiga konfigurasi salah yang sudah aku lewatkan berbulan-bulan.

Buka aja. Ceritakan masalahmu. Persis seperti kamu cerita ke aku.

scenes.text: You're serious.

id.text: Serius kamu.

scenes.text: Monday delivery. Open Bob.

id.text: Deadline Senin. Buka Bob.

scenes.text:
Fine. If this doesn't work I'm blaming you.

...Okay. Opening it now.

id.text:
Baiklah. Kalau nggak berhasil, aku salahkan kamu.

...Oke. Lagi dibuka.

scenes.text:
Sam opens IBM Bob inside VS Code.
For the first time.

id.text:
Sam membuka IBM Bob di dalam VS Code.
Untuk pertama kalinya.

scenes.text:
Friday, 6:08 PM.
Sam closes the Bob chat window.

id.text:
Jumat, 18:08.
Sam menutup jendela chat Bob.

scenes.text: Taylor. It's done.

id.text: Taylor. Selesai.

scenes.text: The whole thing? In two hours?

id.text: Seluruhnya? Dalam dua jam?

scenes.text: Full audit, design system, new page built from scratch, mobile responsive, WCAG contrast passing. Bob even ran a 6-task todo list while it worked and checked them off one by one.

id.text: Audit penuh, design system, halaman baru dibangun dari nol, mobile responsif, kontras WCAG lulus. Bob bahkan membuat daftar 6 tugas sambil bekerja dan mencentangnya satu per satu.

scenes.text: That would have been your entire weekend.

id.text: Itu harusnya bisa memakan seluruh akhir pekanmu.

scenes.text: Easily. And I would've missed the contrast failures. And the viewport meta tag. And the duplicate SEO description. Bob found all of it before writing a single line.

id.text: Mudah. Dan aku pasti melewatkan kegagalan kontras. Dan meta tag viewport. Dan duplikasi deskripsi SEO. Bob menemukan semuanya sebelum menulis satu baris pun.

scenes.text: That's the thing people miss about Bob. It's not autocomplete. It actually reads your files, understands the context, and then decides what needs fixing.

id.text: Itulah yang orang-orang lewatkan soal Bob. Ini bukan autocomplete. Bob benar-benar membaca file-mu, memahami konteksnya, lalu memutuskan apa yang perlu diperbaiki.

scenes.text: It also generated a full report I can hand to the CEO. Contrast ratios, before and after, next steps. I looked like I'd been planning this for weeks.

id.text: Bob juga membuat laporan lengkap yang bisa aku berikan ke CEO. Rasio kontras, sebelum dan sesudah, langkah selanjutnya. Aku terlihat seolah sudah merencanakan ini berminggu-minggu.

scenes.text: How long would this have taken without Bob?

id.text: Berapa lama ini tanpa Bob?

scenes.text: Honestly? Three hours minimum just to audit the old site. Then another four or five to write everything. Sunday night, probably. Stressed the whole time.

id.text: Jujur? Tiga jam minimal hanya untuk mengaudit situs lama. Lalu empat atau lima jam lagi untuk menulis semuanya. Malam Minggu, mungkin. Stres sepanjang waktu.

scenes.text: And now?

id.text: Dan sekarang?

scenes.text:
Now I'm going home at 6 PM on a Friday.

...Okay. You win. Bob is actually insane.

id.text:
Sekarang aku pulang jam 6 sore di hari Jumat.

...Oke. Kamu menang. Bob benar-benar luar biasa.

scenes.text: I told you. It doesn't replace the engineer — it just removes everything that was wasting your time.

id.text: Sudah kubilang. Bob tidak menggantikan engineer — hanya menghilangkan semua yang membuang waktumu.

scenes.text:
Full audit. Premium redesign. Accessibility passing. Report generated.

Friday evening, not Sunday night. That's what Bob is for.

id.text:
Audit penuh. Redesign premium. Aksesibilitas lulus. Laporan dibuat.

Jumat sore, bukan Minggu malam. Itulah kegunaan Bob.

scenes.text:
Sam Rivera shipped the redesign at 6:12 PM on Friday.
The CEO called it "a massive improvement" on Monday morning.

Time saved: ~6 hours.

id.text:
Sam Rivera mengirimkan redesign pukul 18:12 hari Jumat.
CEO menyebutnya "peningkatan besar" pada Senin pagi.

Waktu yang dihemat: ~6 jam.
